description: LABEL RECORDS clause (FD) — obsolete '85 element DELETED by ISO/IEC 1989:2002; the 2023 FD clause set (§2023:13.18) has no LABEL clause. The FIRST removal gate, shipped with the permissive flip (every NIST FD writes this clause).
citation: obsolete '85 FD element DELETED by ISO 2002; the 2023 FD clause set (§2023:13.18) has no LABEL clause; §1985:VII.3.6.2 (REMOVED); VCR Table 7
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. LR.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmlr" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "X" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
